scenes.summary: 主角在清晨的街道上行走，摄像机沿复杂轨迹跟拍

shots.prompt: A young man in a light coat walks slowly down a sunlit street in the early morning. The camera tracks him from a 15-degree frontal angle, pushing in as he walks. The camera smoothly cranes up to a 45-degree overhead angle, holds for 3 seconds, then descends back to eye level. The subject stays centered in frame throughout. Cinematic 24fps, natural lighting, photorealistic.
shots.negative_prompt: jerky camera, sudden cuts, camera clipping through objects, subject out of frame, unstable motion
